subject: Maths
title: Multiplying and dividing algebraic fractions
subtitle: Fractions — Secondary · GCSE Maths
learning_objective: I can multiply and divide algebraic fractions and simplify the result.

key_vocab.definition: To multiply algebraic fractions, multiply numerators together and denominators together. To divide, flip the second fraction and multiply.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can multiply and divide algebraic fractions and simplify the result.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: multiply -- To multiply algebraic fractions, multiply numerators together and denominators together. To divide, flip the second fraction and multiply.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Multiply: top × top, bottom × bottom. Divide: flip the second fraction then multiply. Always cancel common factors.
&frac{a}{b} ÷ &frac{c}{d} = &frac{a}{b} × &frac{d}{c} = &frac{ad}{bc}
KFC: Keep, Flip, Change

Key examples:
  ✓ &frac{2}{x} × &frac{x}{3} = &frac{2}{3}  (cancel x)
  ✓ &frac{x}{3} ÷ &frac{x}{6} = &frac{x}{3} × &frac{6}{x} = 2  (flip and multiply)
  ✓ &frac{x+1}{x} × &frac{x}{x+2} = &frac{x+1}{x+2}  (cancel x)
  ✗ &frac{2}{x} × &frac{3}{x} = &frac{6}{x}  (must multiply denominators too)
  ✗ &frac{a}{b} ÷ &frac{c}{d} = &frac{a}{b} × &frac{c}{d}  (must flip second fraction)

teacher_sections.title: Teacher Key & Mark Scheme
teacher_sections.content:
Award marks for correct working and final answers.

Simple multiplication:
  (a) &frac{1}{2}
  (b) &frac{1}{3}
  (c) 2
  (d) 4

Simple division:
  (a) 2
  (b) 2
  (c) &frac{3}{4}
  (d) &frac{2}{3}

With factorising:
  (a) x
  (b) 2
  (c) 2x
  (d) 2

Harder expressions:
  (a) &frac{x+2}{x+5}
  (b) 2
  (c) x − 2
  (d) x + 3

Mixed operations:
  (a) &frac{3}{2}
  (b) &frac{x+3}{x−2}
  (c) x − 1
  (d) 6
  (e) x + 2
